decisions.statement: A `switch` ends the open stretch and begins the next at one time.
`switch` reads `--at` as the time the open stretch ends and the next begins.
A `switch` finding no stretch open takes the open stretch of the day before.
The stretch a `switch` takes from the day before is a sleep.
A sleep a `switch` ends moves to the day that sleep opened.
The stretch a `switch` begins opens the day that sleep opened.
The day a sleep opened is read from when that sleep began.
A sleep beginning at or after six the evening in Utah opens the day after.
Two days one act changes land in a single commit.
A wall time this command takes or says is a US Mountain time.
A day is named at `--day`.
Nothing here takes `--date`.
`--relationship` names a relationship by its id or by its title.
A title no relationship has is refused rather than written.
A title more than one relationship has is refused.
A relationship a title tags is kept beside one `--relationship` names.
An alias more than one relationship has tags neither and refuses nothing.
An act that sets a title reads that title for aliases.
A `--dry-run` judges the change that would land and writes nothing.
A write here is judged as `check` judges.

definition: the command ending one stretch and beginning the next at one time
